name: TRIZ (Creative Destruction)
deliverable: Systematic cessation of self-sabotaging behaviors and counter-productive habits

steps.text: Invert the goal: ask the room to design the worst possible system, one that guarantees failure.
Draft alone, then build one ruinous list per table.
Circle every item we already do, even slightly.
Stop the worst habit; name an owner and a date.

failure: The audit protects feelings, so the room lists habits that describe someone else's organization.
intervention: Circle an obvious item yourself and ask the room: what else are we pretending we do not do?
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: TRIZ originates with Genrich Altshuller; this creative-destruction version is the Liberating Structures adaptation.
